authority_source: standing meta authority to adjudicate bounded platform/toolchain blockers inside the R3 MAC recovery corridor, combined with the user's instruction to continue bounded changes in the existing task

required_proof.windows: Perform a real x86_64-pc-windows-msvc check of the named touched crates with Windows SDK headers using cargo-xwin/xwin or an equivalent disposable MSVC cross environment, and retain the byte-identical Windows source aggregate. cargo xwin check is accepted as the target-toolchain wrapper for this exact cargo check; a hash alone is not a substitute.
required_proof.linux: Perform the focused x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu check using a disposable cross compiler such as cargo-zigbuild/Zig, a task-external GNU cross toolchain, or an exact-source disposable Linux build environment; retain the Linux cfg/body differential. A macOS-native substitution is not sufficient.
required_proof.capture: Record exact commands, tool versions, target triples, exit status, and external cache/toolchain location.

failure_posture: If genuine target compilation still cannot be produced after bounded disposable provisioning, preserve the same worktree and return a new exact blocker; do not weaken the proof or edit around toolchain failures.
